```python
import http.server

class DenyAccessHandler(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        # Define the URL you want to block
        blocked_url = "/path/to/block"

        # Check if the requested URL matches the blocked URL
        if self.path == blocked_url:
            self.send_response(403)
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(b"Access Denied")
        else:
            # Serve the file normally if it's not the blocked URL
            super().do_GET()

def run(server_class=http.server.HTTPServer, handler_class=DenyAccessHandler):
    server_address = ('', 8000)  # Listen on all interfaces on port 8000
    httpd = server_class(server_address, handler_class)
    print(f"Serving on port {server_address[1]}...")
    httpd.serve_forever()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()
```
